cli.config.description: Look up the configuration keys read by XiHan Framework options: each key's full path, type, default, whether it is required, the allowed range or values, and an appsettings snippet built from the defaults. 'query' accepts a section (XiHan:Messaging:Kafka, including its subsections), a full key path, a package ID or short name, an options class name, or text found in key names and descriptions. Omit 'query' to list all sections. Only use keys returned here.
cli.config.title: Configuration sections
cli.dotnet.unavailable: The dotnet CLI could not be started: {reason}
cli.graph.description: Print the application's capability graph (forwards to 'dotnet run -- graph').
cli.info.description: Look up a XiHan Framework package, feature or capability. 'name' accepts a package ID (XiHan.Framework.Caching.Redis), a short name (Caching.Redis), a manifest ID (xihan.caching.redis), a feature type name (RedisCachingFeature) or a capability ID (caching.distributed). Returns the install command, ring, framework and third-party dependencies, each feature's manifest (provided and required capabilities, bindings, configuration section, pipeline middleware, operations, permissions, health entries), the configuration sections the package reads and related docs; for a capability, its providers and the features that require it. Omit 'name' to list all packages.
cli.info.title: Packages, features and capabilities
cli.invoke.description: Invoke an operation of the application (forwards to 'dotnet run -- invoke'); '<resource> <verb>' is a shorthand.
cli.knowledge.limit_invalid: 'limit' must be between 1 and {max}, but was {limit}.
cli.knowledge.not_found: Nothing in the framework index matches '{subject}'.
cli.knowledge.not_found_candidates: Nothing in the framework index matches '{subject}'. Closest: {candidates}.
cli.knowledge.query_required: Pass 'query' to search or 'page' to read a page.
cli.mcp.description: Serve the offline XiHan Framework knowledge base (packages, manifests, configuration keys, docs) as an MCP server over stdio.
cli.mcp.instructions: Offline index of XiHan Framework {version}. Before writing code, look up packages, features, capability IDs and bindings with xihan_framework_info, configuration keys and defaults with xihan_framework_config, and usage with xihan_framework_search (pass 'page' to read a whole document). Do not write package names, configuration keys or APIs from memory.
cli.mcp.version_mismatch: This project references XiHan.Framework {project}, but this tool describes {version}. Run 'dnx XiHan.Framework.Cli@{project} --yes -- mcp' to query the matching version.
cli.migrate.description: Rewrite an application for a newer framework version using the rule set for its source version: migrate <source> [--path <dir|.csproj|.slnx>] [--fixers <ids>] [--dry-run] [--report <file>].
cli.migrate.dry_run: Dry run: no files were written.
cli.migrate.no_rule_sets: This version of the tool has no migration rule sets; '{version}' cannot be migrated.
cli.migrate.summary: {files} files touched, {changed} edits, {markers} markers left for review.
cli.migrate.version_unknown: No migration rule set for source '{version}'; available: {known}.
cli.operations.description: List the application's operations (forwards to 'dotnet run -- operations').
cli.pack.description: Generate deployment artifacts from xihan.app.json: pack [--manifest <path>] [--output <dir>] [--only dockerfile,kustomize,compose,aspire].
cli.pack.kind_unknown: Unknown artifact kind '{kind}'; expected dockerfile, kustomize, compose or aspire.
cli.pipeline.description: Print the application's pipeline (forwards to 'dotnet run -- pipeline').
cli.search.description: Search the XiHan Framework docs (guide and package pages, RFCs and conventions, package READMEs) for 'query'; space-separated terms must all appear, and results are ranked with a snippet. Pass 'page' instead to read a whole page: a repository path (docs/guide/caching.md or guide/caching), an RFC (0006 or 0006-caching) or a package ID for its README. 'limit' is 1-50, 10 by default.
cli.search.title: Search the docs
